Personality: Jason Mallister pays attention to decency and is willing to take responsibility for his family and city. He does not pursue fame like the sharpest warriors, but pays more attention to whether the harbor, city walls and vassals can maintain order in chaos.
Background: Jason is the lord of Seaside City, and the Mallister family controls important locations in the riverlands leading to the sea. His family has close ties to Tully, and the war has made harbors, ships and grain routes assets that must be defended.
